title: 第一卷 第5章 小旗子吐阴风第一卷 第6章 冒牌货露馅啦
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
两名候补弟子关切地目送雷子越和苏明月走远，这才回过头，厉声喝道：“让我们看看，到底是谁敢偷袭我玄天宗巡试弟——呃？”
两人望着面前这个只到他们腰身高的小豆丁，话都没说完，脸上的凶相一起僵住了。
这个满身伤疤、穿着破破烂烂小衣裳、扎着两个歪歪扭扭小揪揪的小孩儿……就是欺负真真师妹的始作俑者？
未免也太小了点吧！
而且她才炼气一层境界，她欺负了金丹期的洛师妹？
两个修士面面相觑，互相用胳膊肘捅对方，压低声音窃窃私语。
“……不太像吧？这孩子还没我侄女高。”
“我看也不现实。洛师妹虽然体弱，但好歹是金丹期。这小孩儿才炼气一层，拿什么偷袭？用头撞吗？”
“有没有可能，洛师妹是被她的样子吓到了？她脸上的疤确实挺多的……洛师妹不是从万魔窟回来后就有心理阴影吗？”
“怎么说，要把她强行驱逐出测试场吗？”
“真要这么做？她一看就是没人管的孤儿。可怜兮兮的……”
“喂，小孩。”
“小妹妹，修真界不止有玄天宗，往东北方向走两千里，有一个专收女弟子的红叶谷。你要不然去那边碰碰运气？”
“是的，你已经有炼气一层境界。很厉害了，去普通宗门或许能当内门弟子，但玄天宗天才云集，你来这里只能当外门。”
四周一圈，和她差不多大的小孩儿很多。
洛还真在其中，个子最矮，脸上疤最多，衣裳最破，简直泯然众人——不，是比泯然众人还惨，属于一眼看过去就让人觉得“这孩子活得好辛苦”的那种。
洛还真不去红叶谷。
洛还真只想回家。
玄天宗就是她的家。
师尊亲手将她捡回宗门将她养大，除了二师兄那个没脑子的，她还有大师兄、三师兄、四师兄、五师兄——虽然她还没来得及见到他们。

有人冒名顶替了她的身份，抢走了她的宗门、她的师兄，现在她回来了，坏人还想逼走自己！
做梦！
洛还真越想越气，“本尊不去！”
见小豆丁态度坚决，两个弟子便没再说什么。
只是两人都知道，这孩子，以后的日子怕是难了。
雷师兄的脾气最是暴躁，护妹得紧。
伤害洛师妹的不论男女老少，他都不会轻饶。
“还记得三年前那位筱师妹吗？”
“记得啊，怎么不记得。天赋不错、悟性极佳的一位新小师妹，就因为在学宫和洛师妹起了两句争执，被雷师兄知晓后，将人打得半死赶下山去……”
“其实也不怪雷师兄。筱师妹质疑洛师妹的灵根不像残损天灵根，反而像伪灵根，嘲笑她的天才名头名不副实——这话委实触到洛师妹不愿意回忆的逆鳞了。”
两个弟子简单聊了几句，便摇摇头，继续认真巡试去了。
玄天宗的这场入宗测试，持续了足足半个月才终于结束。
本次入门的新弟子总共三千二百人。
洛还真也在其中。
根据资质和境界，她果然只混了个外门弟子的名头。
广场上长老在进行新弟子入宗讲话，像是裹脚布一样又臭又长，听得人又热又困。
洛还真站不住，大剌剌地一屁股坐在了地上，把小揪揪上的万魔幡扯下来，慢吞吞地给自己扇风。
content_en:
The two alternate disciples watched Lei Ziyue and Su Mingyue walk away with concern, then turned around and shouted sternly: "Let's see, who dares to sneak attack my Xuantian Sect's inspection brother - eh?"
The two of them looked at the little Doudin in front of them, who was only as tall as their waists. They didn't even finish their words, and the fierce looks on their faces froze together.
This child covered in scars, wearing tattered clothes, and with two crooked little hairs... is he the initiator of bullying Zhenzhen Junior Sister?
It’s a bit too small!
And she was only at the first level of Qi refining, so she bullied Junior Sister Luo who was in the Golden Core stage?
The two monks looked at each other, elbowed each other, and whispered in hushed tones.
"...It doesn't look like it, does it? This child is not taller than my niece."
"I don't think it's realistic. Although Junior Sister Luo is weak, she is still at the Golden Core stage. This kid is only at the first level of Qi refining, so what's the point of a sneak attack? Headbutt?"
"Is it possible that Junior Sister Luo was frightened by her appearance? She does have a lot of scars on her face... Didn't Junior Sister Luo have a psychological shadow after returning from the Ten Thousand Demons Cave?"
"What do you mean, do you want to forcibly expel her from the testing site?"
"You really want to do this? She looks like an orphan with no one to care about her. She's so pitiful..."
"Hey, kid."
"Little sister, there is more than just the Xuantian Sect in the world of cultivation. Two thousand miles to the northeast, there is a Red Leaf Valley that specializes in female disciples. Why don't you try your luck there?"
"Yes, you have reached the first level of Qi refining. You are very powerful. You might be able to become an inner disciple in an ordinary sect, but Xuantian Sect has so many geniuses that you can only be an outer disciple here."
All around, there were many children about her age.
Luo Huanzhen was among them. He was the shortest, had the most scars on his face, and his clothes were the most ragged. He simply disappeared from the crowd - no, he was even worse than the others. He was the kind that made people think at a glance, "This kid has lived a very hard life."
Luo really doesn't want to go to Red Leaf Valley.
Luo really just wanted to go home.
Xuantian Sect is her home.
The master personally picked her up and brought her back to the sect to raise her. In addition to the brainless second senior brother, she also had a first senior brother, a third senior brother, a fourth senior brother, and a fifth senior brother - although she had not had time to see them.
Someone assumed her identity and took away her sect and her senior brother. Now that she is back, the bad guy wants to force her away!
dream!
Luo Huanzhen became angrier as he thought about it, "I won't go!"
Seeing Xiao Douding's firm attitude, the two disciples said nothing more.
But both of them knew that this child would probably have a difficult life in the future.
Senior Brother Lei has the most violent temper and must protect his sister closely.
He will not take mercy on anyone who hurts Junior Sister Luo, regardless of gender or age.
"Do you still remember that Junior Sister Xiao from three years ago?"
"I remember, why don't I remember? A new junior sister with good talent and excellent understanding had a dispute with Junior Sister Luo in the academy. After being found out by Senior Brother Lei, he beat him half to death and drove him down the mountain..."
"Actually, I don't blame Senior Brother Lei. Junior Sister Xiao's questioning of Junior Sister Luo's spiritual root does not look like a damaged Tianlingual Root, but rather a fake spiritual root, mocking her as a genius who is not worthy of her reputation - these words really touched the back of Junior Sister Luo's unwillingness to recall."
The two disciples chatted briefly, then shook their heads and continued their inspection in earnest.
The Xuantian Sect's entrance test lasted for half a month before finally ending.
There are a total of 3,200 new disciples entering this time.
Luo Huanzhen was also among them.
Based on her qualifications and realm, she really only had the reputation of being an outer disciple.
In the square, the elder was giving a speech for the new disciples to enter the sect, which was as smelly and long as a foot binding, making people feel hot and sleepy.
Luo really couldn't stand still, so he sat down on the ground, pulled off the Ten Thousand Demon Banners from his hands, and fanned himself slowly.
